notes.title: New Language: French ! Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
Game is now available in French ! More languages coming soon.
 Biome 6 is now easier to reach.
 Fixed some impossible dungeons.
 The Checkpoint/Hangar button now requires a delay to click it, avoiding unintentional annoying clicks.
 New custom cursor look.
 Cave Detector now displays if the dungeon is your current objective with a robot face.
 Fixed UI bugs.
 Fixed some aspect ratio bugs.
 Overall gameplay and feel of the game improved.
